marta: Quick checkexternal PT next week. Need final decision on evidence format and KMS access.

kevin: Keep it minimal: ndjson logs + manifest.csv. Add SHA256SUMS and a detached .sig.

lin: Agree. For KMS, no key ARNs to assessors. Use decrypt-proxy that mints a short-lived decrypt session tied to the pt-assessor role. Proxy logs to immutable-audit.

marta: Extension policy? Default token TTL 4h. Extensions require eng-security + infra-oncall signoff. Record approver IDs in manifest.

kevin: Also require exporter sha (Exporter-SHA) in manifest and include the export command used. Makes repro easy.

lin: Retest slots: first at +7 days after ready-for-retest, second at +21. Auto-label `ready-for-retest` when manifest+PR+CI pass.

pt-bot: Note: engagement "boreal" kickoff 2026-05-22T09:00:00Z. Auto-provision ephemeral roles 15m prior.

marta: Action list: Lin - stand up decrypt-proxy + logging; Kevin - write export script + sha header; I'll update ticket template. Dry-run Fri 2026-05-14 15:00 UTC.

lin: On it.

kevin: Will have PoC by Thu.

marta: Thanks all :pray:
